headline: Recommended approval of Teamsters contract and a purchase of four vehicles for up to $195,208; denied a water bill adjustment.
summary: The meeting covered a Teamsters contract, a vehicle purchase, and a water bill request. Members recommended the contract to the Personnel Board and City Council, and recommended a purchase of four vehicles from MHQ for up to $195,208. They denied a request to adjust water charges at 142 Piave St.
decisions: Recommended approval of the Teamsters contract to the Personnel Board and City Council, 4-0.
Recommended that the Purchasing Board approve buying four vehicles from MHQ for not more than $195,208, 4-0.
Denied the water bill adjustment request for 142 Piave St, 4-0.

decision_evidence.quote: A motion to approve the Consent Agenda was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Roberto Moreno.
A motion to recommend approval of the contract to the Personnel Board and City Council was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Roberto Moreno.

The PWSB asked the board to recommend that the Pawtucket Purchasing Board approve the purchase of 4 vehicles from MHQ under the Plymouth County Commissioners Contract for an amount not to exceed $195,208. A motion to approve was made by Jeannine Bourski and seconded by Robert Benson.
Motion to deny the bill adjustment was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Jeannine Bourski.

decision_titles: Purchase of four vehicles from MHQ, up to $195,208
Water bill adjustment request, 142 Piave St
plain_text:
PAWTUCKET WATER SUPPLY BOARD 
 
The 446th meeting of the Pawtucket Water Supply Board met on August 12th, 2026 at 12:00 PM 
William Masuck called the meeting to order at 12:01 PM. 
 
PWSB Members Present 
William Masuck, Chairperson – present    
James Bradford, Vice Chairperson –  not present 
Robert Benson – present 
Roberto Moreno – present  
Mark Theroux – not present 
Jeannine Bourski – present 
 
PWSB Staff Present 
James Decelles - Chief Engineer 
Russell Houde – Assistant Chief Engineer 
Katie Peters – Executive Project Manager 
Mike Lecours – Chief Financial Officer 
 
 
Public Attendees 
None 
 
4.  Consent Agenda 
 
 
Brief discussion of Cumberland wholesale contract and possible Lincoln interconnection.  
A motion to approve the Consent Agenda was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Roberto 
Moreno. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
Roberto Moreno – Yes 
Jeannine Bourski - Yes
APPROVED 
 
5. Executive Session 
A motion was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Roberto Moreno to go into Executive 
Session to discuss Teamsters – Proposed Contract Approval pursuant to RIGL s. 42-46-5 (a)(2) 
Collective Bargaining. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
Roberto Moreno – Yes 
Jeannine Bourski - Yes 
APPROVED 
Executive session started at 12:08 PM. 
 
 
A motion was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Roberto Moreno to go out of executive 
session. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
Roberto Moreno – Yes 
Jeannine Bourski - Yes 
APPROVED 
 
Regular session resumed at 12:18 PM. 
 
 
A motion was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Roberto Moreno to seal the executive 
session minutes. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes
Roberto Moreno – Yes 
Jeannine Bourski - Yes 
APPROVED 
 
 
6A. Teamsters – Proposed Contract Approval 
A motion to recommend approval of the contract to the Personnel Board and City Council was 
made by Robert Benson and seconded by Roberto Moreno. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
Roberto Moreno – Yes 
Jeannine Bourski - Yes 
APPROVED 
 
6B. Vehicle Purchase 
The PWSB asked the board to recommend that the Pawtucket Purchasing Board approve the 
purchase of 4 vehicles from MHQ under the Plymouth County Commissioners Contract for an 
amount not to exceed $195,208. 
A motion to approve was made by Jeannine Bourski and seconded by Robert Benson. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
Roberto Moreno – Yes 
Jeannine Bourski - Yes 
APPROVED 
 
6C. Bill Adjustment Request – 142 Piave St, Pawtucket 
The customer, Philip Kiah, is requesting to have his water charges adjusted on bills from April and 
may 2026. The stated reason was they had a running toilet during this period. The toilet has since 
been fixed.
Based upon a review of the facts and in accordance with PWSB policy it is recommended not to 
grant the adjustment to this account. 
 
Motion to deny the bill adjustment was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Jeannine Bourski. 
 
Roll Call Taken: 
William Masuck - Yes 
Robert Benson – Yes  
Roberto Moreno – Yes 
Jeannine Bourski - Yes 
APPROVED 
 
 
 
Next scheduled meeting is September 8th, 2026. 
A motion to adjourn was made by Robert Benson and seconded by Jeannine Bourski. 
Meeting adjourned at 12:27 pm. 
Certified by PAWTUCKET WATER SUPPLY BOARD, recorded by kp 
 
 
 
 
 
William Masuck, Chairperson
